$comment: ADR D12 (#39): what the two contract schemas in ../beacon/ gain. Each key is a JSON pointer into that file and its value is what goes there. Slice 1 folds in `monitors.schema.json` and slice 2 `status.schema.json`, in the PRs that make the CLI accept and write them, so the contract never runs ahead of `beacon check`.

/$defs/host/properties/jobs.description: The review of this host's launchd or systemd user jobs, by label (ADR D12). A label with no entry is unreviewed. Only the CLI reads this; the app ignores it (ADR D1). `beacon jobs keep|ignore|removed` writes it.

/$defs/label.description: A launchd label or a systemd unit name: no whitespace and no control character.

oneOf.description: Its removal is intended: not shown while it is gone. If it comes back it is unreviewed.
Shown under this name and group; down when it is gone.

/$defs/hostCheck/properties/id.description: Unique within its host. `job-` is reserved for discovered jobs (ADR D12).

status.schema.json./properties/checks/description: Keyed by check id. A check that has not finished its first run is absent. A discovered job has the id `job-<slug of its label>` (ADR D12).

/properties/checks/additionalProperties/.description: Only on a job's row: the kept name, else the job's label. The app shows a row that has a name without a heartbeat monitor (ADR D12).
Only on a kept job's row: its group. A row with a name and no group is unreviewed.
